title_zh: 情緒取向家庭治療（EFFT）低價短課：治療性道歉、無望感回應，10–35 美元
title_en: Low-cost on-demand EFFT short courses by Adèle Lafrance
summary_zh: 情緒取向家庭治療（Emotion-Focused Family Therapy, EFFT）創始人 Adèle Lafrance 的網站有多門隨選短課，其中低於 50 美元的包括「Responding to Hopelessness」（10 美元、20 分鐘）、「Universal Apology in Clinical Practice」（25 美元、45 分鐘）、「Emotion-Focused Homework Ideas」（25 美元、55 分鐘）、「Transforming Childhood Pain」與「Process of Emotional Self-Exploration」（各 35 美元）。EFFT 屬 Greenberg 系的情緒焦點取向（網站引用 Lafrance Robinson、Dolhanty 與 Greenberg 2015 年論文），不是 Sue Johnson 系。
summary_en: Adèle Lafrance, creator of Emotion-Focused Family Therapy (EFFT), offers on-demand short courses, several under US$50: Responding to Hopelessness ($10, 20 min), Universal Apology in Clinical Practice ($25, 45 min), Emotion-Focused Homework Ideas ($25, 55 min), and Transforming Childhood Pain and Process of Emotional Self-Exploration ($35 each). EFFT belongs to the Greenberg emotion-focused lineage (the site cites Lafrance Robinson, Dolhanty & Greenberg, 2015), not Sue Johnson's model.
evidence_note: 培訓課程資訊，非研究證據。
caution: 同名縮寫容易混淆：這裡的 EFFT 是 Lafrance 的 Emotion-Focused Family Therapy（Greenberg 系），不是 ICEEFT 的 Emotionally Focused Family Therapy；短課不等於完整訓練。
verify_reason: 低價短課頁面未列 CE；與 Greenberg 系的關聯依 EFFT 頁面引用的 Lafrance Robinson、Dolhanty 與 Greenberg（2015）論文判斷，課程頁本身未說明。
brief_zh: Greenberg 系情緒焦點取向延伸到家庭與照顧者工作
10–35 美元短課：治療性道歉、無望感回應、作業設計、椅子工作
有專業人員與家長兩類課程，選購前要分清
低價短課未列 CE；完整 EFFT 訓練（2 天）為 419 加元另計
brief_en: Greenberg-lineage emotion-focused work extended to families and caregivers
US$10–35 short courses: apology, hopelessness, homework, chair work
Separate offerings for clinicians and parents
No CE listed for the short courses; full 2-day EFFT is CA$419
supervision_questions: 引導家長對孩子做「治療性道歉」前，你要先評估哪些家長與孩子的準備度？
Greenberg 系的家庭工作和 Sue Johnson 系的 EFFT（Emotionally Focused Family Therapy）在目標和技術上有什麼差別？

related.title_zh: Sue Johnson 親授伴侶 EFT 錄影課，每集 40 美元含 CE
related.title_en: Sue Johnson EFT webinar series on demand with CE
related.summary_zh: 美國 National Register of Health Service Psychologists 提供四集由 Sue Johnson 主講的情緒取向治療（Emotionally Focused Therapy，Sue Johnson 系，非 Greenberg 的 Emotion-Focused Therapy）錄影課，主題包括以依附為本的伴侶介入、EFT Tango 與微介入、Hold Me Tight 對話與依附創傷修復，以及創傷伴侶。每集 40 美元，含 1–1.5 小時 CE，課程等級標示為進階。
related.summary_en: The National Register of Health Service Psychologists offers four recorded webinars by Dr. Sue Johnson on Emotionally Focused Therapy (the Johnson model, not Greenberg's Emotion-Focused Therapy), covering attachment-based couple intervention, the EFT Tango, Hold Me Tight conversations and attachment injuries, and trauma couples. Each costs US$40 including 1–1.5 CE credits; instructional level is advanced.

related.title_zh: Classroom WISE：免費自學的學校心理健康素養課程
related.title_en: Classroom WISE free school mental health literacy course
related.summary_zh: Classroom WISE 由美國 MHTTC 網絡與馬里蘭大學醫學院 National Center for School Mental Health 合作開發，是免費的三部分訓練包，包括自學線上課程、影片庫與資源集。內容涵蓋心理健康素養、辨識學生困擾、降溫技巧、創傷知情與包容的課室環境，對象是 K-12 教師、學校人員與學校心理健康專業人員。
related.summary_en: Classroom WISE, developed by the MHTTC Network with the National Center for School Mental Health at the University of Maryland School of Medicine, is a free three-part package with a self-paced online course, video library and resource collection. It covers mental health literacy, recognizing student distress, de-escalation, trauma-informed and inclusive classrooms for K-12 educators and school staff.

training.provider: MHTTC Network、National Center for School Mental Health（University of Maryland School of Medicine）
training.format: 自學線上課程（含影片庫與資源集）
